_comment: LIVE external-input mesh fixture driven through the ENGINE's own OBJ path. The harness page instantiates the published CanvasRenderer and calls its public loadOBJFromURL (real fetch + engine parseOBJ + engine packing + engine uploadMeshData), then uploads the engine-packed bytes to the harness pipeline under test. The published bundle's parseOBJ is internal-only, so this public CanvasRenderer path is the engine-side parse.
